title: Service-aware system logs filtering and export
acceptance_criteria: System Logs page supports service filtering by curated service buckets and discovered process names.
Service filtering updates visible log table entries and returned-count metric.
Download action exports filtered log entries when a service filter is active.
Existing line count, source, and search behavior remain unchanged.
Frontend typecheck/lint/build and runtime/browser smoke pass.
assumptions: Service matching based on process/message/raw token matching is sufficient for this slice.
Filtered download can be generated client-side without backend API changes.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added service filter selector, dynamic process filter options, filtered table view, and filtered download behavior.
Validated with tsc, lint, build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
Manual review approved: additive frontend-only UX enhancement with no API contract changes.
